headline: 6-0 loss: Bangladesh suffer heavy defeat to South Korea at Asian Games
summary: The women's team has conceded 16 goals without scoring in their first two Group F matches of the tournament.
details: Bangladesh suffered a comprehensive 6-0 defeat against South Korea in their second Group F match at Nagai Stadium in Osaka, Japan, on Thursday.
The loss comes just three days after a record 10-0 drubbing against North Korea in the opening game of the competition.
Coach Peter Butler opted for his strongest starting XI, including Ritu Porna Chakma, Monika Chakma, Shamsunnahar, and Rupna Chakma, but it was not enough to prevent the defeat.
South Korea dominated the match, scoring twice in the first half and adding four more goals after the interval.
Bangladesh has now conceded 16 goals in two matches without managing to score a single goal.
The team will play their final group stage match against Myanmar on Monday.
caption:
16 goals conceded, 0 scored. Bangladesh suffers another heavy loss at the Asian Games.

Bangladesh suffered a comprehensive 6-0 defeat against South Korea in their second Group F match at Nagai Stadium in Osaka, Japan, on Thursday.

The loss comes just three days after a record 10-0 drubbing against North Korea in the opening game of the competition.

Coach Peter Butler opted for his strongest starting XI, including Ritu Porna Chakma, Monika Chakma, Shamsunnahar, and Rupna Chakma, but it was not enough to prevent the defeat.

South Korea dominated the match, scoring twice in the first half and adding four more goals after the interval.

Bangladesh has now conceded 16 goals in two matches without managing to score a single goal.

The team will play their final group stage match against Myanmar on Monday.

headline: Controversial audio clip: Cantonment Police OC withdrawn
summary: Md Rakibul Hasan has been attached to DMP headquarters after a voice recording allegedly criticizing the government and police force went viral.
details: The officer-in-charge (OC) of Cantonment Police Station, Md Rakibul Hasan, has been withdrawn and attached to the DMP headquarters following the circulation of an audio clip on social media.
In the audio recording, a voice allegedly belonging to the OC is heard criticizing the government, administration, the Bangladesh Army, and the police force.

The speaker in the clip claims that police personnel on the ground are weak and suggests that if former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina returns in December, the force would be unable to handle the situation.
The recording also contains allegations of bribery within the police force, claiming that postings are secured through bribes and that senior officials are leaning towards the BNP.
Md Aktar Hossain, deputy commissioner (media) of the DMP, confirmed the withdrawal for administrative reasons and stated that the contents of the audio clip will be examined.
Appropriate action will be taken against the OC if necessary after the investigation into the audio's authenticity and content is completed.
caption:
A police chief is out of his post after a viral audio clip allegedly slams the government and the police force.

The officer-in-charge (OC) of Cantonment Police Station, Md Rakibul Hasan, has been withdrawn and attached to the DMP headquarters following the circulation of an audio clip on social media.

In the audio recording, a voice allegedly belonging to the OC is heard criticizing the government, administration, the Bangladesh Army, and the police force.

The speaker in the clip claims that police personnel on the ground are weak and suggests that if former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina returns in December, the force would be unable to handle the situation.

The recording also contains allegations of bribery within the police force, claiming that postings are secured through bribes and that senior officials are leaning towards the BNP.

Md Aktar Hossain, deputy commissioner (media) of the DMP, confirmed the withdrawal for administrative reasons and stated that the contents of the audio clip will be examined.

Appropriate action will be taken against the OC if necessary after the investigation into the audio's authenticity and content is completed.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #Police #DMP #News

Source: Jamuna TV, The Daily Star
